text:
alex: hey team :wave: I just started and need DB credentials + KMS key access for a feature spike. who do I ask and what's the turnaround?
maya: welcome! :tada: File a secrets request via the internal portal: https://internal.redwood/tools/secrets-request. Use the 'redwood-secret-request' template and include: service name, env (dev/staging/prod), approver (your manager), and justification. Typical SLA: 24h for normal dev requests, 48h for prod/infra-sensitive.
kyler: to add — if it's for a service account, prefer a short-lived token/workload identity instead of long-lived JSON keys. note that ops will reject non-ephemeral creds unless there's a strong reason.
alex: thanks — do I need to list specific KMS key names?
maya: yes, include the KMS key id (eg: projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/ai/cryptoKeys/model-serving). If you don't know it, put the target resource and we'll map it. For prod keys we require @eng-security signoff.
eng-security-bot: automated message — policy check queued for request #SR-772. Required reviewers: eng-security, infra-sre. Expected manual review window: 24–48h.
linda: rotation basics: most service secrets follow a 90-day rotation policy. For app database creds we prefer Vault dynamic secrets (path: secret/data/dynamic/<service>) so rotations are automatic. If you request a static secret, include rotation owner and cadence.
sam: ops note — when requesting DB user, use roles instead of root accounts. Example request snippet to paste into the portal:```
service: alex-feature-proxy
env: staging
resource: projects/redwood-staging/sql/instance-23/databases/payments
access: read/write (role: payments_proxy)
approver: Maya J. (manager)
why: spike for optimizing KV cache eviction
rotation: owner=alex, cadence=90d
```
alex: got it — should I CC anyone on the portal request?
maya: cc your manager and the oncall team if it's prod (sre-oncall). For prod KMS, also tag "eng-security" in the justification so the bot routes it faster.
alex: perfect, I'll open SR-xxx now. thanks all :thumbsup:
eng-security-bot: reminder scheduled — if request remains pending after 48h a reminder will ping @eng-security and the request owner.
